summary: Tested async consultation processing (Whisper + LLM in the background). Backend: new suite tests/test_async_consult.py has 15/15 passing and tests/test_async_consult_extra.py has 1/1 passing. Checked: /start answers in about 0.24s with status processing and the text transcript prefilled; validation returns 400/412/412/401; while processing, PDF, send-report and portal publish return 409; PATCH during processing ignores text fields and keeps the growth value peso 14.6, which survives the AI merge; the visit becomes ready in about 6s; PDF then returns 200; retry on a ready visit returns it unchanged; the list has a status field; legacy POST /consultations works; unknown id returns 404. Audio: a silent WAV went to 'ready' because Whisper invented 'Sottotitoli creati dalla comunità Amara.org'. A corrupt audio file went to failed, retry set it back to processing, the job was kept and it failed again. Server restart resume works: a visit in processing during a backend restart became ready. Found 1 real bug: audio larger than about 12MB returns 500 DocumentTooLarge and leaves an orphan visit stuck in processing. Frontend: everything in the request was verified at 1920 (with a mobile check of the pill at 390). After 'Genera nota clinica' the NoteEditor appears instantly. The old consultation-processing screen is absent. The banner, shimmer placeholders and the 'Elaborazione referto in corso… <name>' pill all show. PDF, Copia, Stampa and Invia ai genitori are disabled during processing. Bodychart opens and closes, CashPanel is visible, the Crescita weight field is editable, and Dati anagrafici opens PatientDialog on top of the overlay with the patient's data. After closing the overlay the pill stays on Agenda, Pazienti, Visite and Cassa. RecentNotes and the Visits row show 'Elaborazione referto in corso…'. After a reload the pill comes back (TrackPending). When ready: the banner and pill disappear, the textareas fill with the ai-filled class, the toast 'Referto pronto · Aurora Ricci' shows without Apri while the editor is open, the weight 14.6 is kept and saved, and PDF is enabled. With the editor closed the toast shows 'Apri', which reopens the ready visit. PDF download works. Failed state: the failed banner and Riprova show, PDF stays disabled, and the RecentNotes card says 'Elaborazione non riuscita · apra per riprovare'. Code review confirmed recording-stop-btn calls api.startConsultation with the audio blob and shows the spinner 'Apertura cartella…', and the consultation-retry screen keeps the blob. Note: holding a visit in processing in the UI was done by flipping status in Mongo (/tmp/toggle.py), because Playwright route.fetch returned 401 in this environment.

critical.issue: The audio is stored inline in consult_jobs as base64 plus seal(), which adds about 85% size. Reproduced: a 13MB audio file returns 500 with pymongo DocumentTooLarge (24.2MB > 16MB). The 25MB limit check is therefore misleading: real recordings over about 12MB fail. Long visits, or Safari/mp4 at a higher bitrate (about 15-25 min), will hit this. Worse, the Consultation is inserted BEFORE the job insert, so it is left orphaned in status 'processing' with no job. The UI pill spins forever until the next server restart marks it failed. Each 'Riprova invio' from the frontend creates another orphan. Fix: store the audio in GridFS or on disk (or chunks); insert the job first, or delete the consultation if the job insert fails; or lower the limit to about 11MB.

minor.issue: Whisper hallucinations on silent or noisy audio are accepted as a transcript. A 2s silent WAV became 'ready' with transcript 'Sottotitoli creati dalla comunità Amara.org', and the LLM built a note from it. Add a blacklist of known hallucination phrases (Amara.org, 'Sottotitoli...', 'Grazie per la visione') and a minimum duration or length, then fail with 'Nessun parlato rilevato'.

If the job is gone (for example 'Elaborazione interrotta' after a restart, or the orphan case), retry returns 410 and the visit stays failed forever. Text fields stay locked as placeholders ('In attesa dell'elaborazione IA') and PDF stays disabled. The doctor has no way to finish the record: no manual paste or editing in the failed state. Allow editing of text fields, or a 'incolla trascrizione' re-submit, for failed visits.

Non-atomic read-modify-write in both directions. The processing branch reads existing, then $sets the full note with no status condition. If the job finishes in between, the AI text fields are overwritten with empty strings. The job's read of current growth followed by $set can likewise drop a growth PATCH. Add a {'status':'processing'} filter, or use field-level $set (note.crescita / note.farmaci).
It sets finalized_at even while the visit is still processing.

asyncio.create_task with no strong reference to the task (only the cid is kept in _RUNNING). Per the Python docs, the task may be garbage-collected mid-run. Keep the tasks in a set and discard them in done_callback.
Raw provider errors reach the doctor UI, e.g. 'Elaborazione IA non riuscita: Failed to transcribe audio: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - ...'. Map these to friendly Italian messages.
Jobs of failed visits, including the sealed audio, are kept indefinitely with no TTL or cleanup (data retention for health data).

ui_bugs.issue: api.updateConsultation is called inside the setNote updater function, which is a side effect in a state updater. Observed 2 identical PATCH requests on ready (StrictMode or double invocation). Move the PATCH out of the updater.

Growth or farmaci edits made during processing are silently lost if the doctor closes the overlay without pressing Salva (the merge happens only while the editor is mounted). Consider autosaving growth on change or blur, or asking for confirmation on close.

issues: The z-[70] pill stays on top of the PatientDialog backdrop and the Bodychart header. At 390px it covers part of the ticker and header area (x 109-378, y 76). Acceptable, but consider hiding it while a modal is open or showing it compact on mobile.
At the top-center it overlaps the patient name heading of the NoteEditor.
Data di nascita uses the browser's native date input rather than the shadcn calendar (pre-existing).

action_items: HIGH: Store audio for consult_jobs outside the Mongo document (GridFS or file), or cap uploads at about 11MB. Also never leave an orphan 'processing' consultation when the job insert fails (insert the job first, or roll back).
Filter Whisper hallucination outputs (Amara.org, etc.) and mark the visit failed with 'Nessun parlato rilevato'.
Give failed visits without a job a way forward: manual text editing or a re-submit transcript option instead of permanently locked fields.
Make the processing PATCH and the job completion race-safe (status filter or field-level $set) and do not set finalized_at while processing.
Keep strong references to the background tasks in spawn_consult_job.
Move the PATCH side effect out of the setNote updater (double PATCH), and consider autosaving growth edits made during processing.
Show friendly ai_error messages instead of raw litellm exceptions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py start_consultation: the Consultation insert happens before the consult_jobs insert (not atomic), and base64+seal inflation breaks the advertised 25MB limit.
server.py update_consultation: the processing branch can overwrite AI results if the job finishes concurrently.
server.py spawn_consult_job: the task reference is not retained.
NoteEditor.jsx: side-effecting API call inside the setState updater.
ConsultationOverlay.jsx: the retry stage reuses rec.seconds for duration. Also, the 'paper' consent state is not reset when the overlay reopens (it carries over to the next free visit).

success_rate.backend: 94% (16/16 pytest pass; 1 extra bug found manually: large audio 500 + orphan)

rca of the issue: Large audio 500: start_consultation writes {'audio': seal(base64(data))} into a single consult_jobs document. Base64 adds 33% and sealing adds more (13MB of raw audio became a 24.2MB BSON document), which exceeds MongoDB's 16MB BSON limit, so insert_one raises DocumentTooLarge. The consultation was already inserted with status 'processing', so it is orphaned. Reproduce with POST /api/consultations/start using a 13MB file 'audio' and paper_consent=true. Mitigation: use GridFS or file storage for the audio, put the job insert first or wrap both inserts in try/rollback, and enforce a realistic size limit.
